Sale Orders.label: Sale Orders
Sale Orders.from_join_clause:
FROM sale_order_item soi
join sale_order so on (soi.`sale_order_id` = so.`id`)
left join address_detail ad1 on soi.`shipping_address_id` = ad1.`id`
left join state s on (s.iso2_code = ad1.state_code and s.country_code = ad1.country_code)
left join `address_detail` ad2 on so.`billing_address_id` = ad2.`id`
left join state s1 on (s1.iso2_code = ad2.state_code and s1.country_code = ad2.country_code)
left join item_type it on soi.`item_type_id` = it.`id`
left join category c on it.`category_id` = c.`id`
left join tax_type tt on tt.id = it.gst_tax_type_id
left join shipping_method sm  on soi.`shipping_method_id` = sm.`id`
left join shipping_package sp on soi.`shipping_package_id` = sp.`id`
left join prefetch_shipping_package_status psps on psps.tenant_id = so.tenant_id and psps.shipping_package_id = sp.id
left join shipping_package_type spt on sp.shipping_package_type_id=spt.id
left join invoice inv on inv.id=sp.invoice_id
left join gst_einvoice gei on gei.invoice_id = inv.id
left join invoice_item invt on invt.id = soi.invoice_item_id
left join return_manifest_item rmi on sp.id = rmi.shipping_package_id
left join reverse_pickup rp on rp.id = soi.reverse_pickup_id
left join reverse_pickup_item rpi on rp.id = rpi.reverse_pickup_id and rpi.sale_order_item_id = soi.id
left join facility f on soi.facility_id = f.id
left join party p on p.id=inv.from_party_id
left join customer cust on cust.id = so.customer_id
left join party p1 on p1.id=cust.id
left join channel ch on so.channel_id = ch.id
left join item i on (soi.item_id = i.id)
left join batch b on b.id = invt.batch_id
left join sale_order_metadata som on som.sale_order_id=so.id and som.type='PARENT_SALE_ORDER_CODE'
LEFT JOIN party p2 ON p2.id = f.id
LEFT JOIN return_manifest rm ON rm.id=rmi.return_manifest_id
LEFT JOIN courier_return  cr ON cr.shipping_package_id = sp.id

fields.label: Sale Order Item Code
fields.expr: CASE WHEN (soi.code REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' and length(soi.code) > 12) THEN concat('`', soi.code) ELSE soi.code END

fields.label: Display Order Code
fields.expr: CASE WHEN (so.display_order_code REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' and length(so.display_order_code) > 12) THEN concat('`', so.display_order_code) ELSE so.display_order_code END

fields.label: COD
fields.expr: case when so.payment_method_code = 'COD' then 1 else 0 end

fields.label: Invoice Code
fields.expr: case when inv.display_code IS NULL  then inv.code else inv.display_code end

fields.label: Shipping Address Name
fields.expr: case when p1.name IS NULL  then ad1.name else p1.name end

filters.label: Added in Date Range
filters.condition: so.created > :addedOnStart and so.created < :addedOnEnd and soi.created > DATE_SUB(:addedOnStart, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)

filters.label: Created at channel in Date Range

Sale Order Margins.label: Sale Order Margins
Sale Order Margins.from_join_clause:
FROM sale_order_item soi
join sale_order so on (soi.`sale_order_id` = so.`id`)
join item_type it on soi.`item_type_id` = it.`id`
join category c on it.`category_id` = c.`id`
left join shipping_package sp on soi.`shipping_package_id` = sp.`id`
left join invoice inv on inv.id=sp.invoice_id
left join invoice_item invt on (invt.invoice_id=inv.id and invt.item_type_id=soi.item_type_id and invt.total=(invt.quantity*soi.selling_price))
left join item i on i.id = soi.item_id
left join inflow_receipt_item iri on iri.id = i.inflow_receipt_item_id
left join inflow_receipt ir on iri.inflow_receipt_id = ir.id
left join purchase_order po on po.id = ir.purchase_order_id
left join party p on p.id=po.vendor_id
left join facility f on soi.facility_id = f.id

fields.label: COD
fields.expr: case when so.payment_method_code = 'COD' then 1 else 0 end

Back Orders.label: Back Orders
Back Orders.from_join_clause:
FROM item_type_inventory_snapshot itis
join item_type it on itis.item_type_id = it.id
join category c on it.category_id = c.id
left join vendor_item_type vit on (vit.item_type_id = it.id and vit.enabled = 1)
left join vendor v on (vit.vendor_id = v.id)
left join party p on (v.id = p.id and p.enabled = 1)

Hopped Orders.label: Hopped orders
Hopped Orders.from_join_clause:
from hopped_sale_order_item_timeline h
left join sale_order so on so.id = h.sale_order_id
join sale_order_item soi on soi.id =h.sale_order_item_id
left join facility f on f.id = soi.facility_id
join item_type it on soi.item_type_id=it.id
join channel c on so.channel_id = c.id
left join user u on h.user_id = u.id

filters.label: Customer Info Contains
filters.condition: (so.customer_name like :customerNameFilter OR so.notification_email like :customerNameFilter OR so.notification_mobile like :customerNameFilter)

Shelfwise Inventory.label: Shelfwise Inventory
Shelfwise Inventory.from_join_clause:
from item_type_inventory iti
left join batch b on (iti.batch_id=b.id)
join item_type it on iti.item_type_id = it.id
join shelf sh on iti.shelf_id = sh.id
join section sec on sh.section_id = sec.id
join category c on it.category_id = c.id
join facility f on (iti.facility_id = f.id)

Inventory Worth.label: Inventory Worth
Inventory Worth.from_join_clause:
from item i
join inflow_receipt_item iri on i.inflow_receipt_item_id = iri.id
join purchase_order_item poi on iri.purchase_order_item_id = poi.id
join item_type it on poi.item_type_id = it.id
join category c on it.category_id = c.id
join facility f on i.facility_id = f.id

Inventory Worth By Category.label: Inventory Worth By Category
Inventory Worth By Category.from_join_clause:
from item i
join inflow_receipt_item iri on i.inflow_receipt_item_id = iri.id
join purchase_order_item poi on iri.purchase_order_item_id = poi.id
join item_type it on poi.item_type_id = it.id
join category c on it.category_id = c.id

Inventory Aging.label: Inventory Aging
Inventory Aging.from_join_clause:
from item i
join item_type it on i.item_type_id=it.id
join category c on it.category_id=c.id
left join shelf s on s.id = i.shelf_id
left join inflow_receipt_item iri on iri.id=i.inflow_receipt_item_id
left join vendor v on v.id = i.vendor_id
left join party p on p.id = v.id
left join inflow_receipt ir on iri.inflow_receipt_id=ir.id
left join facility f on i.facility_id = f.id
left join putaway put on put.id=i.putaway_id

Inventory Ledger.label: Inventory Ledger
Inventory Ledger.from_join_clause:
from inventory_ledger il
join item_type it on il.sku_code = it.sku_code
left join ledger_sku_opening_counter lsoc on il.facility_id = lsoc.facility_id and il.sku_code = lsoc.sku_code

fields.label: Opening Balance
fields.expr: case when il.created=MIN(il.created) then (case when lsoc.counter is NULL then 0 when old_balance = -99999 then lsoc.counter else  old_balance end )  else  NULL end

fields.label: GRN Count(Add)
fields.expr: SUM(case when transaction_type = 'GRN' then abs(quantity)  else 0 end)

fields.label: Inbound Gatepass Stock Transfer(Add)
fields.expr: SUM(case when transaction_type = 'INBOUND_STOCK_TRANSFER' then abs(quantity)  else 0 end)

fields.label: Outbound Gatepass Return Count(Add)
fields.expr: SUM(case when transaction_type = 'OUTBOUND_GATE_PASS_RETURN' then abs(quantity)  else 0 end)

fields.label: Putaway Cancelled/Return Count(Add)
fields.expr: SUM(case when transaction_type = 'RETURN' then abs(quantity)  else 0 end)

fields.label: Inventory Adjustment Count
fields.expr: SUM(case when transaction_type = 'INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENT' then abs(quantity)  else 0 end)

fields.label: Invoice Count(Less)
fields.expr: SUM(case when transaction_type = 'INVOICE_CREATION' or transaction_type = 'SALE_ORDER_DISPATCH' then abs(quantity)  else 0 end)

fields.label: Outbound Gatepass Count(Less)
fields.expr: SUM(case when transaction_type = 'OUTBOUND_GATE_PASS' then abs(quantity) else 0 end)

fields.label: Closing Balance
fields.expr: (case when il.created=MIN(il.created) then (case when lsoc.counter is NULL then 0 when old_balance = -99999 then lsoc.counter else  old_balance end )  else  0 end) + sum(quantity)

Inventory Adjustment.label: Inventory Adjustment
Inventory Adjustment.from_join_clause:
from inventory_adjustment ia
left join item_type it on (ia.sku_code=it.sku_code)
left join facility f on (ia.facility_id=f.id)

Reorder Report.label: Reorder Report
Reorder Report.from_join_clause:
from reorder_config rc
join item_type it on rc.item_type_id = it.id
join facility f on rc.facility_id = f.id
join item_type_inventory_snapshot itis on it.id=itis.item_type_id
join vendor_item_type vit on it.id = vit.item_type_id
left join category c on c.id = it.category_id

Fast Moving SKU.label: Fast Moving SKU
Fast Moving SKU.from_join_clause:
from  item_type it
join item_type_inventory_snapshot itis on it.id=itis.item_type_id

Expiring/Expired Inventory.label: Batching Expired Inventory
Expiring/Expired Inventory.from_join_clause:
from item_type it
join item_type_inventory iti on it.id = iti.item_type_id
join batch b on iti.batch_id = b.id
join shelf s on s.id = iti.shelf_id
join category c on it.category_id=c.id

filters.label: Expired or About to Expire
filters.condition: case when strcmp(:expiredAboutToExpireFilter,'expired')=0 then expired=true when strcmp(:expiredAboutToExpireFilter,'about_to_expire')=0 then about_to_expire=true when strcmp(:expiredAboutToExpireFilter,'both')=0 then expired=true or about_to_expire=true end

Purchase Orders.label: Purchase Orders
Purchase Orders.from_join_clause:
from purchase_order_item poi
join purchase_order po on poi.purchase_order_id = po.id
join user u on po.user_id = u.id
join vendor v on po.vendor_id = v.id
join party p on v.id = p.id
join item_type it on poi.item_type_id = it.id
left join tax_type tt on tt.id = it.gst_tax_type_id
join category c on it.category_id = c.id
join facility f on po.facility_id = f.id

GRN.label: GRN
GRN.from_join_clause:
from inflow_receipt_item iri
left join batch b on iri.batch_id=b.id
join inflow_receipt ir on iri.inflow_receipt_id = ir.id
join user u on ir.user_id = u.id
join purchase_order_item poi on iri.purchase_order_item_id = poi.id
join item_type it on iri.item_type_id = it.id
join purchase_order po on poi.purchase_order_id = po.id
join vendor v on po.vendor_id = v.id
join party p on v.id = p.id
join category c on c.id=it.category_id
join facility f on ir.facility_id = f.id
LEFT JOIN putaway_entity_mapping pem ON pem.inflow_receipt_id = ir.id
LEFT JOIN putaway pu ON pu.id = pem.putaway_id

fields.label: Values of Goods Received without taxes
Values of Goods Received with taxes
Values of Goods Rejected without taxes

GRN-PO Mapping.label: GRN-PO Mapping
GRN-PO Mapping.from_join_clause:
from inflow_receipt_item iri
left join batch b on iri.batch_id=b.id
join inflow_receipt ir on iri.inflow_receipt_id = ir.id
join user u on ir.user_id = u.id
join purchase_order_item poi on iri.purchase_order_item_id = poi.id
join item_type it on iri.item_type_id = it.id
join purchase_order po on poi.purchase_order_id = po.id
join vendor v on po.vendor_id = v.id
join party p on v.id = p.id
join category c on c.id=it.category_id
join facility f on ir.facility_id = f.id

fields.label: Values of Goods Received without taxes
Values of Goods Received with taxes

Vendors.label: Vendors
Vendors.from_join_clause:
from vendor v
join party p on (v.id = p.id)
left join party_contact_type pct on (pct.code='PRIMARY')
left join party_contact pc on (pc.party_contact_type_id = pct.id and pc.party_id = p.id)
left join party_address_type addr1Type on (addr1Type.code='SHIPPING')
left join party_address addr1 on (addr1Type.id = addr1.party_address_type_id and addr1.party_id = p.id)
left join state addr1State on (addr1.state_code = addr1State.iso2_code and addr1State.country_code = addr1.country_code)
left join party_address_type addr2Type on (addr2Type.code='BILLING')
left join party_address addr2 on (addr2Type.id = addr2.party_address_type_id and addr2.party_id = p.id)
left join state addr2State on (addr2.state_code = addr2State.iso2_code and addr2State.country_code = addr2.country_code)
left join vendor_agreement va on (va.vendor_id = v.id  and va.name not like 'TRANSIT%')
left join user u on (u.id=v.user_id)

Vendor Item Master.label: Vendor Item Master
Vendor Item Master.from_join_clause:
from vendor_item_type vit
join item_type it on vit.item_type_id = it.id
join vendor v on vit.vendor_id = v.id
join party p on v.id = p.id
join facility f on p.facility_id=f.id

Vendor Catalog.label: Vendor Catalog
Vendor Catalog.from_join_clause:
from vendor_item_type vit
join item_type it on vit.item_type_id = it.id
join vendor v on vit.vendor_id = v.id
join party p on v.id = p.id

ASN.label: ASN report
ASN.from_join_clause:
from purchase_order po
join advance_shipping_notice asn on asn.purchase_order_id = po.id
join advance_shipping_notice_item asni on asni.advance_shipping_notice_id = asn.id
join purchase_order_item poi on poi.id = asni.purchase_order_item_id
join item_type it on it.id = poi.item_type_id
join party p on po.vendor_id = p.id

Channel Item Type Sync.label: Channel Item Type Report
Channel Item Type Sync.from_join_clause:
from channel_item_type cit
left join item_type it on cit.item_type_id = it.id
left join channel_item_type_price citp on cit.id = citp.channel_item_type_id
left join channel ch on ch.id = cit.channel_id

Facility.label: Facility
Facility.from_join_clause:
from facility f
join party p on f.id = p.id
join party_address pa1 on pa1.party_id = p.id
join party_address_type pat1 on pat1.id = pa1.party_address_type_id and pat1.code = 'BILLING'
left join state s1 on (s1.iso2_code = pa1.state_code and s1.country_code = pa1.country_code)
join country c1 on c1.code = pa1.country_code
join party_address pa2 on pa2.party_id = p.id
join party_address_type pat2 on pat2.id = pa2.party_address_type_id and pat2.code = 'SHIPPING'
left join state s2 on (s2.iso2_code = pa2.state_code and s2.country_code = pa2.country_code)
join country c2 on c2.code = pa2.country_code
LEFT JOIN gst_einvoice_seller_credentials gesc ON p.id = gesc.party_id

fields.label: Daily Max Order Processing Capacity Enabled

Facility Alias.label: Facility Alias
Facility Alias.from_join_clause:
from facility_alias fa
left join facility f on f.`id` = fa.`facility_id`
left join party p on p.`id` = f.`id`

fields.label: Channel
fields.expr: case when fa.source_type = 'CHANNEL' then fa.code else '' end

fields.label: Shipping Provider
fields.expr: case when fa.source_type = 'SHIPPING_PROVIDER' then fa.code else '' end

Facility Time Slot.label: Facility Time Slot
Facility Time Slot.from_join_clause:
from facility_time_slot ft
left join facility f on f.id = ft.facility_id
left join party p on p.id = ft.facility_id

fields.label: Facility Slot Start Time as HH:mm:ss
Facility Slot End Time as HH:mm:ss

Facility Allocation Rules.label: Facility Allocation Rules
Facility Allocation Rules.from_join_clause:
FROM facility_allocation_rule fa
left join party p on p.id = fa.facility_id
left join tenant t on t.id = fa.tenant_id

Facility Enable.label: Facility Enable
Facility Enable.from_join_clause:
from facility f
join party p on f.id = p.id
join party_address pa1 on pa1.party_id = p.id
join party_address_type pat1 on pat1.id = pa1.party_address_type_id and pat1.code = 'BILLING'
left join state s1 on (s1.iso2_code = pa1.state_code and s1.country_code = pa1.country_code)
join country c1 on c1.code = pa1.country_code
join party_address pa2 on pa2.party_id = p.id
join party_address_type pat2 on pat2.id = pa2.party_address_type_id and pat2.code = 'SHIPPING'
left join state s2 on (s2.iso2_code = pa2.state_code and s2.country_code = pa2.country_code)
join country c2 on c2.code = pa2.country_code

fields.label: Daily Max Order Processing Capacity Enabled

Item Master.label: Item Master
Item Master.from_join_clause:
from item_type i
left join batch_group bg on i.batch_group_id = bg.id
left join bundle b on (i.id = b.item_type_id)
left join bundle_item_type bit on (bit.bundle_id = b.id)
left join item_type bi on (bit.item_type_id = bi.id)
left join tax_type tt on i.tax_type_id = tt.id
left join tax_type gst on gst.id = i.gst_tax_type_id
join category c on i.category_id = c.id

Item Barcodes.label: Item Barcodes
Item Barcodes.from_join_clause:
from item i
join item_type it on i.item_type_id=it.id
join category c on it.category_id=c.id
left join inflow_receipt_item iri on iri.id=i.inflow_receipt_item_id
left join inflow_receipt ir on iri.inflow_receipt_id=ir.id
left join shelf s on s.id = i.shelf_id
left join purchase_order_item poi on poi.id = iri.purchase_order_item_id

Category.label: Category
Category.from_join_clause:
from category c
left join tax_type gst on c.gst_tax_type_id = gst.id
left join tax_type tt on c.tax_type_id = tt.id

Category Section Mapping.label: Category Section Mapping
Category Section Mapping.from_join_clause:
from category_section_mapping csm
left join category c on csm.category_id = c.id
left join section s on csm.section_id = s.id

Dropship Facility Item Master.label: Dropship Facility Item Master
Dropship Facility Item Master.from_join_clause:
from item_type it
join facility_item_type fit on fit.item_type_id = it.id
join category c on c.id = it.category_id
join facility f on f.id = fit.facility_id
join party p on p.id = f.id

Tax Type Configuration.label: Tax Type Configuration
Tax Type Configuration.from_join_clause:
from tax_type tt
join tax_type_configuration ttc on tt.id = ttc.tax_type_id
join tax_type_configuration_range ttcr on ttc.id=ttcr.tax_type_configuration_id

Users.label: Users
Users.from_join_clause:
from user u
join user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.id
left join role r on r.id = ur.role_id
left join facility f on f.id = ur.facility_id

Users Detailed View.label: Users detailed view
Users Detailed View.from_join_clause:
from user u
join tenant t on t.id = u.tenant_id

Putaway.label: Putaway
Putaway.from_join_clause:
from putaway_item pui
join putaway pu on pui.putaway_id=pu.id
left join batch b on pui.batch_id=b.id
left join shelf s on pui.shelf_id = s.id
join item_type it on it.id=pui.item_type_id
join user u on u.id=pu.user_id
join category c on c.id=it.category_id

GRN/Gatepass to Putaway.label: GRN/Gatepass to Putaway
GRN/Gatepass to Putaway.from_join_clause:
from putaway_item pui
join putaway pu on pui.putaway_id = pu.id
left join batch b on pui.batch_id = b.id
left join shelf s on pui.shelf_id = s.id
join item_type it on it.id = pui.item_type_id
join user u on u.id = pu.user_id
join category c on c.id = it.category_id
left join putaway_entity_mapping pem on pem.putaway_id = pu.id
left join inflow_receipt ir on ir.id = pem.inflow_receipt_id
left join outbound_gate_pass ogp on ogp.id = pem.outbound_gate_pass_id

fields.label: Quantity
fields.expr:
CASE 
            WHEN pui.status_code = 'COMPLETE' THEN pui.putaway_quantity 
            WHEN pui.status_code = 'PENDING' THEN pui.quantity - pui.putaway_quantity 
            ELSE 0 
        END

Pending Putaways.label: Pending Putaways New
Pending Putaways.from_join_clause:
from shipping_package sp
join sale_order so on sp.sale_order_id = so.id
join channel c on so.channel_id = c.id
join address_detail ad on ad.id = sp.shipping_address_id
left join state st on (st.iso2_code = ad.state_code and st.country_code = ad.country_code)
left join shipping_package_type spt on sp.shipping_package_type_id = spt.id
left join sale_order_item soi on soi.shipping_package_id = sp.id
left join invoice inv on sp.invoice_id = inv.id
left join item_type it on (soi.item_type_id = it.id)
left join picklist pl on (pi.picklist_id=pl.id)

filters.label: Picklist Code
filters.condition: sp.code in (select distinct shipping_package_code from picklist_item left join picklist on (picklist.id=picklist_item.picklist_id) where code = :picklistFilter  and facility_id=:facilityId)

filters.label: Shipping Info contains
filters.condition: (sp.shipping_provider_code like :providerFilter or sp.shipping_provider_name like :providerFilter or sp.tracking_number like :providerFilter)

Reverse Pickup.label: Reverse Pickup
Reverse Pickup.from_join_clause:
from reverse_pickup_item rpi
join sale_order_item soi on rpi.sale_order_item_id=soi.id
join sale_order so on so.id = soi.sale_order_id
join channel ch on so.channel_id=ch.id
join item_type it on soi.item_type_id=it.id
join reverse_pickup rp on rp.sale_order_id=so.id and rpi.reverse_pickup_id=rp.id
join reverse_pickup_action rpa on rp.action_code=rpa.code
join shipping_package sp on soi.shipping_package_id=sp.id
left join sale_order rso on rp.replacement_sale_order_id = rso.id
left join shipment_tracking shp on rp.shipment_tracking_id = shp.id
left join putaway pt on rp.putaway_id=pt.id

fields.label: Total Received Items
fields.expr: (select count(rpi.id) from reverse_pickup_item rpi where rpi.reverse_pickup_id = rp.id group by rpi.reverse_pickup_id )

fields.label: QC Comment
fields.expr: (select putaway_comment from reverse_pickup_item rpi where rpi.sale_order_item_id= soi.id and rpi.reverse_pickup_id=soi.reverse_pickup_id)

fields.label: Reverse Pickup Created By
fields.expr: (select email from user u where u.id= pt.user_id)

fields.label: Putaway Created By
fields.expr: (select email from user u where u.id= pt.user_id)

Reverse Pickup Payments.label: Reverse Pickup Payments
Reverse Pickup Payments.from_join_clause:
from reverse_pickup rp
join sale_order so on so.id = rp.sale_order_id
join sale_order_item soi on soi.reverse_pickup_id = rp.id
left join sale_order replacement_so on replacement_so.id = rp.replacement_sale_order_id

Return Manifest.label: Return Manifest
Return Manifest.from_join_clause:
from return_manifest_item rmi
join return_manifest rm on rmi.return_manifest_id = rm.id
join 
			shipping_package sp on rmi.shipping_package_id = sp.id
join sale_order so on sp.sale_order_id=so.id
join channel ch on so.channel_id=ch.id
join 
			user u on rm.user_id = u.id
left join reshipment rs on rs.id=sp.reshipment_id

Return Invoices.label: Return Invoices
Return Invoices.from_join_clause:
FROM sale_order_item soi
join sale_order so on (soi.`sale_order_id` = so.`id`)
join item_type it on soi.`item_type_id` = it.`id`
left join shipping_package sp on soi.`shipping_package_id` = sp.`id`
left join invoice inv on inv.id=sp.invoice_id
left join invoice_item invt on  invt.id = soi.invoice_item_id
left join invoice invr on invr.id = sp.return_invoice_id
left join return_manifest_item rmi on sp.id = rmi.shipping_package_id
left join facility f on soi.facility_id = f.id

fields.label: Unit Price
fields.expr: sum(CASE WHEN (invt.unit_price) is NULL THEN 0.00 ELSE (invt.unit_price) END)

fields.label: CGST
fields.expr: sum(CASE WHEN (invt.central_gst) is NULL THEN 0.00 ELSE (invt.central_gst) END)

fields.label: IGST
fields.expr: sum(CASE WHEN (invt.integrated_gst) is NULL THEN 0.00 ELSE (invt.integrated_gst) END)

fields.label: SGST
fields.expr: sum(CASE WHEN (invt.state_gst) is NULL THEN 0.00 ELSE (invt.state_gst) END)

fields.label: UTGST
fields.expr: sum(CASE WHEN (invt.union_territory_gst) is NULL THEN 0.00 ELSE (invt.union_territory_gst) END)

fields.label: CESS
fields.expr: sum(CASE WHEN (invt.compensation_cess) is NULL THEN 0.00 ELSE (invt.compensation_cess) END)

Courier Returns.label: Courier Returns
Courier Returns.from_join_clause:
from sale_order so
join shipping_package sp on so.id = sp.sale_order_id
            inner
join shipment_tracking_status sts on sts.code = sp.shipment_tracking_status_code
            inner
join shipping_package_status sps on sps.id = sts.shipping_package_status_id and sps.code = 'RETURN_EXPECTED'
left join reshipment re on so.id = re.sale_order_id
left join reshipment_action rpa on rpa.code = re.action_code
left join channel c on c.id = so.channel_id
left join return_manifest_item rmi on rmi.shipping_package_id = sp.id
left join return_manifest rm on rm.id = rmi.return_manifest_id
left join user rm_u on rm_u.id = rm.user_id
left join putaway p on p.id = sp.courier_return_putaway_id and p.type = 'PUTAWAY_COURIER_RETURNED_ITEMS'
left join user p_u on p_u.id = p.user_id
join facility f on f.id = sp.facility_id
left join facility  rf on rf.id = sp.return_facility_id

filters.label: Sale Order Created In Date Range

Putback Pending.label: Putback Pending All Facility
Putback Pending.from_join_clause:
from shipping_package sp
join sale_order so on sp.sale_order_id = so.id
join channel c on so.channel_id = c.id
join address_detail ad on ad.id = sp.shipping_address_id
left join state st on (st.iso2_code = ad.state_code and st.country_code = ad.country_code)
left join shipping_package_type spt on sp.shipping_package_type_id = spt.id
left join sale_order_item soi on soi.sale_order_id = so.id
left join invoice inv on sp.invoice_id = inv.id
left join item_type it on (soi.item_type_id = it.id)
left join picklist pl on (pi.picklist_id=pl.id)
left join facility fa on soi.facility_id = fa.id
left join invoice_item invt on invt.id = soi.invoice_item_id
left join party pa on pa.id = fa.id
left join item_type_inventory iti on soi.item_type_inventory_id = iti.id
left join shelf sh on iti.shelf_id = sh.id
left join batch ba on ba.id = iti.batch_id

filters.label: Picklist Code
filters.condition: sp.code in (select distinct shipping_package_code from picklist_item left join picklist on (picklist.id=picklist_item.picklist_id) where code = :picklistFilter  and facility_id=:facilityId)

filters.label: Shipping Info contains
filters.condition: (sp.shipping_provider_code like :providerFilter or sp.shipping_provider_name like :providerFilter or sp.tracking_number like :providerFilter)

Shipping Package.label: Shipping Package
Shipping Package.from_join_clause:
from shipping_package sp
left join sale_order so on sp.sale_order_id = so.id
left join channel c on so.channel_id= c.id
left join pick_set ps on sp.pick_set_id = ps.id
left join pick_bucket_slot pbs on pbs.shipping_package_id = sp.id
left join invoice inv on inv.id=sp.invoice_id
left join shipping_method sm on sp.shipping_method_id = sm.id
left join address_detail addr on sp.shipping_address_id = addr.id
left join shipping_manifest_item shmi on shmi.shipping_package_id=sp.id
left join shipping_manifest shm on shmi.shipping_manifest_id=shm.id
left join return_manifest_item rmi on rmi.shipping_package_id=sp.id
left join return_manifest rm on rmi.return_manifest_id=rm.id
left join shipping_package_type spt on spt.id = sp.shipping_package_type_id
left join picklist pl on pbs.picklist_id = pl.id

fields.label: Cash On Delivery
fields.expr: case when so.payment_method_code = 'COD' then 1 else 0 end

Picklist.label: Picklist
Picklist.from_join_clause:
from picklist p
join picklist_item pi on pi.picklist_id = p.id
join sale_order so on pi.sale_order_code =so.code
join user u on u.id = p.user_id
join item_type it on (it.sku_code = pi.sku_code and it.tenant_id = :tenantId)
left join batch b on (b.code=pi.batch_code and b.tenant_id = :tenantId)

Invoice.label: Invoice
Invoice.from_join_clause:
from sale_order_item soi
left join invoice_item invi on invi.id = soi.invoice_item_id
left join invoice_item_tax invit on invi.id = invit.invoice_item_id
left join invoice inv on inv.id = invi.invoice_id
left join shipping_package sp on sp.invoice_id = inv.id
join sale_order so on so.id = sp.sale_order_id
join item_type it on it.id = invi.item_type_id
join category c on it.category_id = c.id
left join tax_type tt on (tt.id = it.gst_tax_type_id or tt.id = c.gst_tax_type_id)
left join channel ch on ch.id = so.channel_id

fields.label: Invoice Total
fields.expr: invi.subtotal + invit.central_gst + invit.integrated_gst + invit.state_gst + invit.vat + invit.cst + invi.shipping_charges + invi.cash_on_delivery_charges

Shipping Manifest.label: Shipping Manifest
Shipping Manifest.from_join_clause:
from shipping_manifest_item smi
join shipping_manifest shm on smi.shipping_manifest_id = shm.id
join channel ch on shm.channel_id = ch.id
join shipping_package sp on smi.shipping_package_id = sp.id
join address_detail ad on ad.id = sp.shipping_address_id
join shipping_package_type spt on sp.shipping_package_type_id=spt.id
join sale_order so on so.id = sp.sale_order_id
join user u on shm.user_id = u.id

fields.label: Shipping Method
fields.expr: (select name from shipping_method where id = sp.shipping_method_id)

Box / Packslip.label: Box Packslip Report
Box / Packslip.from_join_clause:
from box_item bi
left join box b on bi.box_id = b.id
left join sale_order_item soi on soi.id = bi.sale_order_item_id
left join sale_order so on so.id = soi.sale_order_id
left join item_type it on it.id = soi.item_type_id
left join shipping_package sp on sp.id = soi.shipping_package_id
left join invoice inv on inv.id = sp.invoice_id
left join channel ch on ch.id = so.channel_id

Gatepass.label: Gatepass
Gatepass.from_join_clause:
from outbound_gate_pass_item ogpi
left join shelf s on ogpi.shelf_id = s.id
left join outbound_gate_pass ogp on ogpi.outbound_gate_pass_id = ogp.id
left join gate_pass_order gpo on ogp.gate_pass_order_id = gpo.id

left join user u on u.id = ogp.user_id

Inbound Gatepass.label: Inbound GatePass

HSN Summary Report.label: HSN Summary Report
HSN Summary Report.from_join_clause:
from invoice_item invi
join invoice_item_tax invit on invi.id = invit.invoice_item_id
left join invoice inv on inv.id = invi.invoice_id
left join shipping_package sp on sp.invoice_id = inv.id
left join item_type it on invi.`item_type_id` = it.`id`
left join tax_type tt on tt.id = it.gst_tax_type_id

fields.label: Sum of Invoice Value
fields.expr: (sum(invi.subtotal) + sum(invit.integrated_gst) + sum(invit.central_gst) + sum(invit.state_gst) + sum(invit.compensation_cess) + sum(invit.union_territory_gst) + sum(invi.shipping_charges) + sum(invi.cash_on_delivery_charges))

Sales Forecast Report.label: Sales Forecast Report
Sales Forecast Report.from_join_clause:
from sale_order_item soi
join item_type it on ( it.tenant_id = :tenantId and soi.item_type_id = it.id
join category c on it.category_id = c.id
join item_type_inventory_snapshot itis on itis.item_type_id = it.id

Aggregate Sales Report.label: Aggregate Sales Report
Aggregate Sales Report.from_join_clause:
FROM sale_order_item soi
join sale_order so on soi.sale_order_id = so.id
left join address_detail ad2 on so.billing_address_id = ad2.id
left join state s1 on s1.iso2_code = ad2.state_code and s1.country_code = ad2.country_code
left join item_type it on soi.item_type_id = it.id
left join tax_type tt on tt.id = it.gst_tax_type_id
left join shipping_package sp on soi.shipping_package_id = sp.id
left join invoice inv on inv.id=sp.invoice_id
left join invoice_item invt on invt.id = soi.invoice_item_id
left join facility f on soi.facility_id = f.id
left join party pf on f.id = pf.id
left join channel ch on so.channel_id = ch.id

fields.label: SGST
fields.expr: (select sum(state_gst/invt.quantity) from invoice_item_tax  where invt.id = invoice_item_id)

fields.label: CGST
fields.expr: (select sum(central_gst/invt.quantity) from invoice_item_tax where  invt.id = invoice_item_id)

fields.label: IGST
fields.expr: (select sum(integrated_gst/invt.quantity) from invoice_item_tax  where invt.id = invoice_item_id)

Cycle Count Overall Data.label: Cycle Count Overall Data
Cycle Count Overall Data.from_join_clause:
from cycle_count_item cci
join cycle_count_shelf_summary ccss on cci.cycle_count_shelf_summary_id=ccss.id
join user u on ccss.user_id=u.id
join sub_cycle_count scc on ccss.sub_cycle_count_id=scc.id
join cycle_count cc on scc.cycle_count_id=cc.id
join shelf s on ccss.shelf_id=s.id
join item_type it on it.sku_code=cci.sku_code
join vendor_item_type vit on it.id=vit.item_type_id
join party p on vit.vendor_id=p.id
join vendor v on p.id=v.id

Cycle Count Report.label: CYCLE_COUNT_REPORT
Cycle Count Report.from_join_clause:
from cycle_count c
left join sub_cycle_count scc on scc.cycle_count_id = c.id
left join cycle_count_shelf_summary ccss on ccss.sub_cycle_count_id = scc.id
left join shelf s on s.id = ccss.shelf_id
left join user u on ccss.user_id = u.id

fields.label: Shelf updated
fields.expr: case when ccss.active = 0 then ccss.updated else '' end

Shelf Report.label: Shelf Report
Shelf Report.from_join_clause:
from shelf sh
left join shelf_type sht on sh.shelf_type_id = sht.id
left join section sec on sh.section_id = sec.id
left join pick_set ps on ps.id = sec.pick_set_id
